translation.name: Deus Harere Aibaky Sesus mymyspirikpoko naha

content: Sakeu Sesus humo meky watu niyzik.
Sesus Serikoho bo zumukuze.
Kyze Sakeu Serikoho ezekta okyrysaro bykyktsa. Tsinamyrẽta. Kytsa namy zikziakseke. Imyspihikbatanikita. Tsiokyrysarozubarẽta tu iwatatu batu nyny ziky.
Atakta: — Sesus ziny tsihikik tahi nikara. Iwatahi isoho piwaby — niy. Batu ibo zikozo. Iypykzezebyita hi nikara. Kytsa sizubarẽtsa zihirizabanaha iwatahi Sesus ty batu tyny.
Tsihokdaharẽta. Iwatahi ske buruk siharaze niparak. Hwi ske sak eze tu buruhua tabo nido. — O abahi Sesus tykara tabo mozumu kaopuke buruk harakmo myze ibo mokozo — mytsaty niy.
Kyze Sesus iopuke buruk izumuzakaze jo bo iktsa niy. Sesus: — O aidytynykta. Tynasikta! Sakeu pe niy. Aba uta awahoro bo mynakozore. Abaze dyhy my — niy. Yhỹ niy.
Iwaze Sakeu aidy sarapuruk niy. Tsakurẽta iwahoro bo zumunahaze.
Ustsa kytsa tihi: — O Sesus tisorekrẽta baze tu modyhyky. Batu imysapy — nikaranaha.

Kyze wahoro eze Sesus nipamykysobaze Sakeu kyik niy. Sakeu: — O nezeba kytsa okyrysaro iaksebaik. Iksispihikbataikik Sesus. Abaka mahani kasorok. Kaokyrysaro ty tsapukte buruk pinyny. Siakubyrinikitsa bo nyny my. Sinamybyikitsa bo nyny my — niy.
Sesus: — Iwa wasani. Jaba ikia apokzi ikzumu. Ikia bo iknakara patsumuẽhĩ iky. Mekywatu tsimozik.
Ustsa ikia wata sisopyksapybyikitsa tu mykaranaha. Iwatahi mybarawy bo ikzumu. Sisopyksapybyikitsa tu nikaranaha asahi meky watu moziknaha zeka Deus bo mysioktyhyryk — niy.
Maku tatsumuẽhĩtsa bo okyrysaro zisirezo ana soho humo Sesus nisihyrinymyryky.
Ziwabynahatsa bo nipamykysokozo. Aba Serusarẽhe zumubahanikinahaze iwatahi Sesus aparakbaha nisihyrinymyryky. Kytsa — Aba ja Deus tyryktsa mozumunaha — mytsaty ahabyitsa nikaranaha.
Iwaze Sesus ispe niy: — Kyze maku myhyrizikwanita nokponi mokuru. Meky botu mokuru. Myzumuze ispehatsa mozik tsihikik niy. Bykyze myziksizoze.

Ijobyitu tatsumuẽhĩtsitsa mytsyhyrytsa watsa tuk mopamykysoko. Ispe niy: “Uta ikiahatsa bo ouro ty ahawa tu nyny my. Ouro mytsyhyrytsa waha ty nyny my. Ahawatu nyny nyny my” iwa nyny mykara. Ouro humo tarabaja tsimahaze puẽtsik tsipiaksenaha. Iwataha — niy. Iwa ispe niyze niparak.

Meky botu niukuru. Kyze itukytsa ihumo batu siakparawy. Kytsa sakyriukrẽtsa. Iwatsahi wastuhu kytsa maku myhyrizikwani bo niukurunaha. Iwaze ibo zumunahaze. Kytsa tihi: — O katsaktsa batu ikia humo makparawy. Kyzekta ikia abaka mypehatsa byita tuzik — niaha.
Iwatatu maku myhyrizikwani ispehatsa niyzik. Iwaze tahudikhudikwy ziksizoze tatsumuẽhĩtsitsa bo nisihuahua. Iwaze sitsumuẽhĩtsitsa ibo zumunaha ispe niy: — Hawa sa ouro ty tsikykaranaha — niy.
Tapara estuba zubata tapehatsa pe niy: — O kapehatsa ikia estuba ouro ty kabo nyny tsiky. Ta humo katsyhyrytsa wa iakse — niy.

Myhyrizikwanita tihi: — O katsumuẽhĩtsa tsamysapyrẽta ikia wasani tsikykara. Ouro ty estuba zuba abo nyny ikyta tu abazuba tsisararawy. Iwatahi ikia bo hudikhudikwy mytsyhyrytsa watsa nyny my. Iwaha tyziperyky tsimy. Ikia ispehatsa tsimozik — niy.
Usta tsumuẽhĩtsa ipe niy: — O kapehatsa ikia kabo ouro ty estuba nyny tsiky ta humo mytsyhyry wa iakse — niy.
Iwatahi maku myhyrizikwanita tihi: — Ikia hudikhudikwy mytsyhyry wa tyziperyky. Ikia ispehatsa tsimozik — niy.
Usta tsumuẽhĩtsa ipe niy: — O kapehatsa ouro ty estuba kabo nyny tsikahaty taty abo nynyzo my. Utakta panu eze iakwaraka, jokpitsĩhik. Aba kino estuba zuba my.

Ikia pokso kapybyrẽta hi ikykara. Ikia batu amy tsumuẽhĩ tsihikik. Ikia humo hi kytsa sinamybyitsa. Ikia namy tsizubarẽna. Ikia kino nyny nynybyity. Ikia waratok sizonita bo batu ziksiparik. Tsinasizozeke zuba. Kyrizykbyitatu tsinasizozeke zuba. Iwa sitsumuẽhĩtsa nitsasoko — Sesus niy.

Iwaze myhyrizikwanita zibetsakak ipe niy: — O batu amysapy. Ikia katsumuẽhĩtsa batu apasara tsihik. Batu imysapy aharere humo zuba piwatawy. Ikia mytsaty tsimy utsa kytsa tysinamybyiwyky. Ikia mytsaty tsimy nyny ahabyitatuze kanamy ziakseke zuba. Ikia mytsaty tsimy kapairikihibara tu pizozeke zuba.
Iwatahi amy skaraba maku okyrysaro perytsa bo ouro ty batu nyny tsiky. Iwazeka abaka ouro puẽtsik zuba tsipiakse niy. Iwa myhyrizikwanita — niy.
Iwaze sinytsitsa pe niy: — Ouro ty estuba zubataty okoktaha! Iwaze maku katsyhyrytsawa ibo nyny tahaktsa — niy.
Sinytsitsa tihi: — O mypehatsa, atakta botu ouro katsyhyrytsawaha niy — niaha.
Myhyrizikwanita tihi: — Utakta wasani mykara. Maku tsinamyrẽta tu namy ty abazuba ibo nyny my. Maku inamybyita tsikaeni zuba my zeka piakseba — niy.

Abaka kasukyrytsitsa kabo tynasioktyhyknaha. Kahumo siharerewabymybarẽtsa. Niahatsahi kape niaha: — O ikia batu mykparawy. Ikia mypehatsa byita tuzik niaha. Aba kaokze tu tysibanaha — niy! Iwatsahi sisukyrytsitsa nisibaiknaha.
Sesus Serusarẽhe bo zumuku.
Kyze Sesus Serusarẽhe bo zinymyrykynahatsa haraze niukuru,
Bytykara wa sihudikhudikwy zumubahaninahaze Betipake myzubaha bara. Betanija hara jobonikita Oriwereja inarokoha pauk baze niy. Sesus zumuze tatuktsa petoktsa nispeha.
Iwa ispe niy: — Sihudikhudikwy bo pãotaha kytsa! Atsezubaha tsimypupunahaze pikuza tsibik tsipipiktumunaha. Atahi isoikãihikta niy. Ibete dyhyhukbyita niy. Satsukyktaha! Kabo tyzioktyhyknaha!
Aty ahape: “Amo maha zeka”. Myhyrinymyrykytsa tihi mype tyoktyhyrykspyk. Niahatsahi tsimykaranaha. Bykyze ahabo tasirezo tsimaha — niy.
Kyze zumunahaze wasani pikuza bo zumunaha. Sesus nikara nahawa tihi ibo zumunaha.
Zisatsuknahaze zihitsa ispe niy: — Hawa skaraba tsimykaranaha — niy.
— O myhyrinymyrykytsa mype kabo tyzioktyhyknahaktsa niaha tsahi tsimykaranaha — niaha.
Sesus bo zioktyhyryknaha, tahasuk pikuza bete zizozokonaha. Iwaze Sesus ibete nido.
Kytsa ske buruk tahakpyzazawy zipaparakanaha. Sesus ykparawytsa tahakpyzazawy zipaparakanaha.
Oriwereja tsahara inasikze iapiktsa sizubarẽtsa sakurẽtsa. Siaksoho opykrẽtsa inakaranaha: — O Deus tsamysapyrẽta. Sesus zuba awata mynakara — nikaranaha.
— Deus Sesus zipehaka. Deus pauk bazekta tu katsa mybo izumu. Atakta tsimysapyrẽta. Atahi abazubata bijoikpe eze tu niy. Bijoikpe iknyktsitsa ihumo sakurẽtsa — nikaranaha.
Pariseutsa sitazahara eze Sesus bo nipamykysokonaha. Ipe niaha: — O myhyrinymyrykytsa zinymyrykynahatsa pe aksobyitahatykta! Siharere ka batu imysapy — niaha.
Sesus tihi: — Aparakbaha soso ahabyizeka haraharetsa kaka maha — nikara.
Sesus Serusarẽhe ezektsa humo nipuziuku.
Sesus Serusarẽhe zumubahaneze nipuziuku. Nawa nikara.
— O Serusarẽhe ezektsa! Tsinymyrykynaha zeka aty ahahumo tsimynakokozo. Awatutaha. Abaka batu ahahyrinymyry.
Bykyze ahasukyrytsitsa mozumunaha. Ahudikhudikwy myzipykbaiknaha. Pahahurukwybaiknaha. Ahudikhudikwy pok taba piukunaha, paikpa piukunaha.

Nanabyitaba ahasukyrytsitsa zuba. Ahawahoro myzipykba. Wahoro ezektsa niwatihi nasipyk. Haraharetsa harape betektsa mynatsubanaha. Ikiahatsa Deus mozumuze pahaoktyhyryk ana humo hi batu ahahyrinymyry.
Sesus Deus wahoro zubata isturupeze bo nitsuk.

Kyze Sesus Deus wahoro zubata isturupeze bo nitsuk. Anaeze kytsa bo nikozo. Kytsa tahanamy zihuakaknaha. Okyrysaro ty kytsa bo nyny nikaranaha. Iwatahi nisiksiwyky Sesus ispe niy: — Nabo pãotaha! niy.
Deus harere niy: “Atakta uta kawahoro zubata Deus bo mynapamykyso.” Iwa botu ziwatahakanaha. Ikiahatsa hi kawahoro sitsyhyryboarẽtsa parik wa tsikzoknihiknaha — niy.
Zibyituhukutu Sesus Deus wahoro zubata isturupeze nisihyrinymyryky. Taparaktsa ziknapamykysokonahatsitsa, Deus harere humo sihyrinymyrytsitsa iwatahatsitsa iwatsa Sesus humo batu siakparawy.
Iwatsahi taparaktsa Sesus zibezekyzykynaha. Ustsa kytsa pokso sipybyrẽtsa nikaranaha tsahi batu. Kytsa sizubarẽtsa Sesus ziwabytoktokonaha.
